item.content:encoded: It might be a bit of a necro post, but in case anyone is still wondering, the heart is still 'connected' to the body of SCP-418, as in that blood coming in and out of the hart is transported to the corresponding vessels by means unknown. In this case, they have cut out its hart and placed it in a incineration chamber. SCP-418 is not impervious to fire. If SCP-418 ever becomes a risk, they flip the switch and instantly destroy the heart, thus terminating the blood flow of SCP-418, and thus SCP-418 itself. It is a killswitch

This article was written in 2010. The Punk Hazard arc started in 2012. The "holding the heart hostage" idea was done here first.

As for the similarity between 418 and Buggy's devil fruit, the two characters are treated very differently and even their powers work somewhat differently (418 splits up only when he is injured). I think the author just came to the natural conclusion that a person who splits apart is going to need to not bleed out and die immediately every time he splits apart.
